title: Work Journal: a new card's hint spills out of the card, and cards cannot be reordered
summary: A new empty Work Journal card's hint no longer spills below the card, and cards can now be reordered with up/down arrows and Alt+Up/Alt+Down (drag also works in the pop-out window); 7 new tests, merged on the green local gate because there are no CI minutes.
friction: PanelBody.test.tsx's beforeAll warm-up timed out in the reviewer's full suite with 10 copies, skipping 8 tests and turning a local gate red for a file the story never touched; filed as issue #676 (panel-body tests time out in their warm-up under the full parallel suite)
lessons_learned: On Windows, Tauri's default file-drop handling swallows HTML5 drag and drop in the webview, so any in-page drag (TipTap drag handles included) needs dragDropEnabled:false on that window or a non-drag alternative
